changes: Add New Game on the opening screen and in Settings. A native confirmation names the current club and explains that roster, balances, season and pending match will reset. Cancel, Escape and closing the dialog do not change the club. Cancel receives initial focus.

Confirmed restart creates a validated empty club with12000coins, zero progress and mandatory tutorial step0; it preserves graphics quality and leaves global audio preferences and asset caches intact. An importable previous-club snapshot is stored before replacing the primary save. A storage failure leaves the current club/UI unchanged. Primary and normal fallback point to the fresh game after a successful reset.

Offer current backup export in the confirmation and last pre-restart backup export in Settings. Normal new-game progress never overwrites that dedicated snapshot; a subsequent confirmed restart replaces it with the immediately preceding club. Optional Help replay uses its own memory storage.

Compact opening actions and static confirmation layout fit narrow phones, landscape, Fold/tablet and desktop; enlarged fonts remain inside their boxes. A one-frame coach refresh after mounting avoids missing the first tutorial target when the confirmation closes.

Web-only release; the1.52Android APK remains unchanged. Simulation, maps, artwork, audio and ordinary economy are preserved; engine display version changes to1.54. Source and verification include current tests and prior release history; no new Android signing certificate is issued.
notes: Website/source updated; existing1.52APK unchanged. Previous signing key is unavailable after ephemeral runtime restart; no replacement certificate was issued.
Only remix31 and original18redirect changed on main. Protected28published and209parent hashes match; original case bot unchanged.

Opening/Cancel/Escape do not reset; confirmation stores importable previous-club snapshot first. Failure preserving snapshot or primary leaves old main/UI unchanged. If only mirroring the normal fallback fails after primary success, new club remains active with save warning.
90normal/enlarged layout states across15sizes; actual new-game flow, native backup bridge mock, partial tutorial/reload and last snapshot persistence. Physical installation not tested.
Prior version53web fixture used for actual worker24→25 upgrade; controllerchange awaited before offline assertion.
